description_en: Queries the configuration information of IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnAttachments接口查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的配置信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-attachments --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --vpn-connection-id vco-p0w2jpkhi2eeop6q60000 --attach-type CEN --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnAttachments

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page when using paging. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。默认值：10。取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection.

If you do not specify the IPsec-VPN connection ID, the system queries all IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances in the current region
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接ID。

如果您不输入IPsec连接ID，系统默认查询当前地域下所有已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息
parameters.name: vpn_connection_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of resource to which the IPsec-VPN connection is attached. Default value: CEN.

The value can only be CEN, which indicates that the system queries IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances
parameters.help_zh:
IPsec连接绑定的资源类型。默认值：CEN。

仅取值：CEN，表示查询已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息
parameters.name: attach_type

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries per page when using paging
PageSize.description_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned

VpnAttachments.description_en: The list of IPsec-VPN connections that are associated with transit router instances
VpnAttachments.description_zh: 已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息列表

items.description_en: The information about an IPsec-VPN connection that is associated with a transit router instance
items.description_zh: 已绑定转发路由器实例的IPsec连接的信息

AttachType.description_en: The type of resource to which the IPsec-VPN connection is attached. The value is CEN, which indicates that the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a transit router instance
AttachType.description_zh: IPsec连接绑定的资源类型。仅取值：CEN，表示当前IPsec连接绑定了转发路由器实例

CrossAccountAuthorized.description_en:
Indicates whether the IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a transit router instance that belongs to a different Alibaba Cloud account.

true: The IPsec-VPN connection is associated with a cross-account transit router instance.
false: The IPsec-VPN connection is not associated with a cross-account transit router instance
CrossAccountAuthorized.description_zh:
IPsec连接是否绑定了跨账号的转发路由器实例。

true：是。
false：否

Description.description_en: The description of the IPsec-VPN connection

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the IPsec-VPN connection

Name.description_en: The name of the IPsec-VPN connection

Tag.description_en:
The system tags of the IPsec-VPN connection.

You can use the system tags to check whether the IPsec-VPN connection supports BGP. You can ignore the other properties.

BGPSupport: indicates whether the IPsec-VPN connection supports BGP.
true: Supported.
false: Not supported
Tag.description_zh:
IPsec连接的系统标签。

通过系统标签您可以了解IPsec连接是否支持BGP功能，其余属性无需关注。

BGPSupport：表示IPsec连接否支持BGP功能。
true：支持。
false：不支持

Tags.description_en: The list of tags associated with the IPsec-VPN connection

TransitRouterId.description_en: The instance ID of the forward routing vRouter to which the IPsec-VPN connection is attached
TransitRouterId.description_zh: IPsec连接绑定的转发路由器实例ID

TransitRouterName.description_en: The name of the transit router instance
TransitRouterName.description_zh: 转发路由器实例的名称

TunnelBandwidth.description_en:
The bandwidth specification of a single VPN tunnel. Valid values:
Standard (default): Standard. The default bandwidth is 1 Gbit/s.
Large: Large. The default bandwidth is 3 Gbit/s
TunnelBandwidth.description_zh:
用于说明VPN单条隧道的带宽规格，取值：
Standard（默认值）：标准型，默认带宽1Gbps
Large（大型）：大型，默认带宽3Gbps
TunnelBandwidth.title_en:
用于说明VPN单条隧道的带宽规格，取值：
Standard（默认值）：标准型，默认带宽1Gbps
Large（大型）：大型，默认带宽3Gbps
TunnelBandwidth.title_zh:
用于说明VPN单条隧道的带宽规格，取值：
